First release of the Switch side.

Added
-----

* Switch module that streams the screen to the PC over the local network or a USB-C cable, starting by itself after boot.
* Game video at 1280×720, 30 or 60 fps, with game audio.
* 1080p mode: games draw their docked picture also in handheld mode and stream at up to 30 fps.
* HOME, system menus and overlays shown too, switching automatically when you leave a game.
* No delay build-up: on a slow network the picture skips ahead instead of falling behind.
* NXStream app on the Switch with Status, Connection, Games, HOME and System sections, usable with the buttons or the touchscreen.
* Video quality presets: Standard, High, Very high, High 60 and Very high 60.
* Bitrate, frame rate and HOME capture settings you can change one by one.
* The console tells the PC app its name and which game is running, for the Discord status.
* Sleep, restart, power off and docking work while NXStream is running.
* Automatic updates for the Switch app, asked at every start.
